title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(髙橋茂樹研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Takahashi Shigeki)
educationalGoal: Achieving following abilities to be a civil engineer (1) Be able to conduct experiments, analyses or surveys. (2) Be able to design, construct, and maintain infrastructure. (3) Be able to explain the processes and effects involved in infrastructure. (4) Be able to analyze social changes taking the future into consideration. (5) Be able to develop sustainable society.
advice: In the Takahashi laboratory, projects of road engineering, especially pavement engineering are carried out in the Design Project III. A main theme will be proposed to each student by the supervisor. Students will find issues related to the main theme through documents study and literature review as a first step. Second, make a research plan for the project, then conduct the necessary lab tests, field surveys etc. After that they will summarize their findings. Solutions will be conceived and implemented in accordance with plans formulated by the students themselves. In this course, each student proceeds with their project under the instruction of the supervisor. The following details the activities for each semester. First semester: Besides documents and lecture notes, students refer to specific papers and journals. By doing this literature survey, students obtain basic knowledge of pavement engineering. Then students make presentations outlining their theme, background on their project, and their project plan. Second semester:Projects planned in the first semester are carried out by individuals or teams to their conclusion. A minimum of 450 hours of learning time is required in this course. Preparation and review times shown in this syllabus are minimum values.
requiredKnowledge: Students need an understanding of Road engineering and Pavement engineering, and a series of previous studies as the Takahashi lab's activities in the last year.

activityGoals.body: Students can explain purpose of the subject selected by themselves.
Students can make plans to solve their chosen problems.
Students can conduct activities to solve their problems.
Students can analyze the results of their activities.
Students can summarize the achievement of project and to explain it clearly.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students can conceive rational ideas about construction and infrastructure maintenance with the support of their supervisor. Students can find methodologies to solve their chosen issues and conduct experiments, analysis and/or surveys appropriate to their methodology. Students can present the achievement of their projects to professionals and students. Students will always act in accordance with engineering ethics.
achievementLevels.standard: Students can conceive rational ideas about construction and infrastructure maintenance with the guidance of their supervisor. Students can find methodologies to solve their chosen issues and conduct experiments, analysis and/or surveys based on the guidance of the instructor and master's students. Students can present their project achievements to others. Students will always act in accordance with engineering ethics.
